title: .locals3.json
description: The buckets and seed data a project needs in Local S3.

buckets.description: The buckets to create. The buckets named by "seed" are created too.

items.description: A bucket name: 3 to 63 lowercase letters, numbers, periods and hyphens, beginning and ending with a letter or number.

seed.description: The local files or directories to import, by object path, by bucket.

additionalProperties.description: The local files or directories to import into this bucket, by object path.

A local file or directory, relative to the directory of .locals3.json; absolute paths and ~/ are accepted. A file is imported as the object path, or under it if it ends with /. The files of a directory are imported under the object path.
